description: Executive Order 14110 was signed on October 30, 2023 and published at 88 FR 75191 on November 1, 2023.
evidence: Executive Order 14110: Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence: By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the laws of the United States of America, it is hereby ordered as follows:

description: Executive Order 14110 directed OMB to issue guidance on agency AI use within 150 days (Sec. 10.1(b)).
evidence: Executive Order 14110: Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence: within 150 days of the date of this order and updated periodically thereafter, the Director of OMB

description: OMB issued M-24-10 on March 28, 2024 as its guidance on agency AI governance, innovation and risk management.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-24-10: Advancing Governance, Innovation, and Risk Management for Agency Use of Artificial Intelligence: this memorandum directs agencies to advance AI governance and innovation while managing risks from the use of AI in the Federal Government

description: M-24-10 took effect on issue, March 28, 2024.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-24-10: Advancing Governance, Innovation, and Risk Management for Agency Use of Artificial Intelligence: this memorandum establishes new agency requirements and guidance for AI governance, innovation, and risk management

description: Under M-24-10 the minimum practices covered safety-impacting AI and rights-impacting AI.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-24-10: Advancing Governance, Innovation, and Risk Management for Agency Use of Artificial Intelligence: this memorandum requires agencies to follow minimum practices when using safety-impacting AI and rights-impacting AI

description: Under M-24-10, agencies had to apply the minimum practices by December 1, 2024 or stop using the AI.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-24-10: Advancing Governance, Innovation, and Risk Management for Agency Use of Artificial Intelligence: by December 1, 2024, or else stop using the AI until they achieve compliance

description: Under M-24-10 each agency had to designate a Chief AI Officer within 60 days of March 28, 2024.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-24-10: Advancing Governance, Innovation, and Risk Management for Agency Use of Artificial Intelligence: Within 60 days of the issuance of this memorandum, the head of each agency must designate a CAIO.

description: Under M-24-10 each CFO Act agency had to convene its AI governance body within 60 days.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-24-10: Advancing Governance, Innovation, and Risk Management for Agency Use of Artificial Intelligence: Within 60 days of the issuance of this memorandum, each CFO Act agency must convene its relevant senior officials

description: Under M-24-10 each CFO Act agency had to publish an AI strategy within 365 days.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-24-10: Advancing Governance, Innovation, and Risk Management for Agency Use of Artificial Intelligence: Within 365 days of the issuance of this memorandum, each CFO Act agency must develop and release publicly

description: OMB issued M-24-18 on September 24, 2024 on the responsible acquisition of AI, building on M-24-10.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-24-18: Advancing the Responsible Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government: this memorandum directs agencies to improve their capacity for the responsible acquisition of AI

description: M-24-18 took effect on issue, September 24, 2024; its rules for other AI contracts applied 180 days after issuance.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-24-18: Advancing the Responsible Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government: This memorandum shall apply to any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of this memorandum

description: Under M-24-18, contracts for rights- or safety-impacting AI had to comply with M-24-10 no later than December 1, 2024 (contracts identified by November 1, 2024).
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-24-18: Advancing the Responsible Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government: No later than December 1, 2024, agencies shall

description: Executive Order 14148 of January 20, 2025 revoked Executive Order 14110 (Sec. 2, item (ggg)).
evidence: Executive Order 14148: Initial Rescissions of Harmful Executive Orders and Actions: The following executive actions are hereby revoked: [...] (ggg) Executive Order 14110 of October 30, 2023

description: Executive Order 14179 of January 23, 2025 set a new AI policy (Sec. 2) and ordered a review of actions taken under the revoked Executive Order 14110.
evidence: Executive Order 14179: Removing Barriers to American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence: all policies, directives, regulations, orders, and other actions taken pursuant to the revoked Executive Order 14110 of October 30, 2023

description: M-25-21 of April 3, 2025 rescinded and replaced M-24-10.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-25-21: Accelerating Federal Use of AI through Innovation, Governance, and Public Trust: This memorandum rescinds and replaces Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Memorandum M-24-10

description: M-24-10 was rescinded and replaced by M-25-21 on April 3, 2025.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-25-21: Accelerating Federal Use of AI through Innovation, Governance, and Public Trust: This memorandum rescinds and replaces Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Memorandum M-24-10

description: Under M-25-21 the minimum practices cover high-impact AI: AI whose output is a principal basis for decisions or actions with a legal, material, binding or significant effect on rights or safety.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-25-21: Accelerating Federal Use of AI through Innovation, Governance, and Public Trust: agencies are directed to implement minimum risk management practices for AI that could have significant impacts when deployed ("high-impact AI")

description: Under M-25-21, agencies must document the minimum practices for high-impact AI within 365 days of April 3, 2025, and safely discontinue non-compliant use.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-25-21: Accelerating Federal Use of AI through Innovation, Governance, and Public Trust: Within 365 days of the issuance of this memorandum, agencies must document implementation of the minimum practices in Section 4(b)

description: Under M-25-21 each agency must retain or designate a Chief AI Officer within 60 days of April 3, 2025.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-25-21: Accelerating Federal Use of AI through Innovation, Governance, and Public Trust: Within 60 days of the issuance of this memorandum, the head of each agency must retain or designate a Chief AI Officer (CAIO).

description: Under M-25-21 each CFO Act agency must convene an AI Governance Board within 90 days.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-25-21: Accelerating Federal Use of AI through Innovation, Governance, and Public Trust: Within 90 days of the issuance of this memorandum, each CFO Act agency must convene its relevant agency officials

description: Under M-25-21 each CFO Act agency must publish an AI Strategy within 180 days.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-25-21: Accelerating Federal Use of AI through Innovation, Governance, and Public Trust: Within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy

description: M-25-22 of April 3, 2025 rescinded and replaced M-24-18 on AI acquisition.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-25-22: Driving Efficient Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government: This memorandum rescinds and replaces OMB Memorandum M-24-18

description: M-24-18 was rescinded and replaced by M-25-22 on April 3, 2025.
evidence: OMB Memorandum M-25-22: Driving Efficient Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government: This memorandum rescinds and replaces OMB Memorandum M-24-18
